content.value: Make sentences with the following structures using the words given in brackets
(i) Subj. + Liking verb + Noun Complement.(Be verb as verb)
(ii) Subj. + Intransitive verb + Adv. of manner.(Sleep as verb)
(iii) That + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of manner + Verb + Adj. complement. (Work and is as verb)
(iv) Not only + Subj. + but also + Subj. + Verb + Adv. (Play as verb)
(v) Subj. + Verb + Adv. + So that + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of place. (Work and enrich as verb).
